mapper.select: SELECT ast40_owner_capital_id AS owner_capital_id, ast40_std_date AS std_date, ast40_amt AS amt, ast40_note AS note FROM ast40_owner_capital WHERE CAST(extract(year from ast40_std_date) AS text) = #{stdYear} AND ast40_company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT ast40_owner_capital_id AS owner_capital_id, ast40_std_date AS std_date, ast40_amt AS amt, ast40_note AS note FROM ast40_owner_capital WHERE ast40_owner_capital_id = #{ownerCapitalId} AND ast40_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ast40_owner_capital (ast40_owner_capital_id, ast40_company_id, ast40_std_date, ast40_amt, ast40_note) VALUES (#{ownerCapitalId}, #{companyId}, #{req.stdDate}, #{req.amt}, #{req.note})
